Mutations in COL2A1 disrupt the proper formation of collagen fibrils, which in turn impairs extracellular matrix organization. This leads to the skeletal abnormalities observed in both spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia congenita and multiple epiphyseal dysplasia, Beighton type, including abnormal epiphyses, short trunk, and scoliosis.

Genetic counseling and prenatal diagnosis can also be informed by this shared mechanism.
